Xennial Director of AI Strategy here. Look out, kids. Grew up on Nintendo, learned DOS on a 386SX, spent time on BBS's, watched AOL rise and fall, the iPhone, cellular, Web N.0, Napster, and now my voicemail is an AI assistant I coded and voice with LLMs.
